semiconductor_relevance: Medium — HITEC Power Protection provides critical power solutions that support semiconductor manufacturing processes, ensuring uninterrupted power supply.
summary: HITEC Power Protection specializes in delivering dynamic uninterruptible power supply (DUPS) systems that ensure mission-critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing operate without interruption. Their innovative power solutions are designed to meet the high demands of modern semiconductor operations, providing reliable and conditioned power.
capabilities: Dynamic UPS systems with flywheel energy storage

regional_presence.Europe: HITEC operates from its head office and manufacturing facility in Almelo, Netherlands, with regional support centers across Europe.
regional_presence.Americas: The company has regional support centers in the Americas to provide service and support.
regional_presence.Asia Pacific: HITEC has a presence in Asia Pacific with subsidiaries in Japan, Malaysia, China, and Taiwan.
